channel.title: The Chemical Engineer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Chemical Engineer (thechemicalengineer.com)

item.title: bp reports rise in downstream emissions; Shell continues decline
item.description: bp reported a significant increase in downstream greenhouse gas emissions in 2025, according to its latest annual filings, while rival Shell recorded a continued decline from its 2019 levels.

item.title: Water desalination plants damaged in Iran and Bahrain
item.description: IRANIAN and Bahraini water desalination plants have been damaged by attacks amid the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, officials from both countries said.

item.title: UPDATE: NASA confirms April Artemis II launch
item.description: THE FIRST crewed mission to the Moon in more than 50 years is now scheduled to launch in April after NASA engineers identified and resolved a helium flow fault affecting the Artemis II rocket.

item.title: Urenco and Babcock face prosecution over uranium oxide release
item.description: NUCLEAR engineering companies Urenco ChemPlants and Babcock Critical Services are to be prosecuted after a 2024 incident at an enrichment site in the UK led to a uranium oxide release.

item.title: Back-up power line restored to Europe’s largest nuclear plant during ceasefire in Ukraine
item.description: FEARS of a nuclear accident at Europe’s largest atomic power plant have eased after a back-up power line connecting the site to an external electricity source was restored.

item.title: Overhaul of safety and environment rules will make UK ‘nuclear nation’ - Starmer
item.description: SIR KEIR Starmer has said a regulatory overhaul for British civil and defence nuclear projects will help the UK “reclaim its place as a leading nuclear nation”.

item.title: Turkmenistan remains ‘hotspot’ for methane emissions, according to satellite data
item.description: GLOBAL methane emissions from the oil and gas sector remain dominated by plumes from Turkmenistan, according to satellite measurements analysed by researchers in California.

item.title: Seville awarded Davidson medal for ‘lifelong commitment’ to ChemEng mentoring
item.description: FORMER IChemE president Jonathan Seville has been awarded the 2026 Davidson medal for his “lifelong commitment to excellence in mentoring”.

item.title: Syngenta announces US$130m expansion to UK agricultural research centre
item.description: SWISS agrochemicals company Syngenta has announced plans to invest US$130m in a new agricultural bioscience centre at its existing research and development (R&D) hub in Bracknell, UK.

item.title: bp to sell German refinery in bid to save US$1bn
item.description: BRITISH oil and gas giant bp has agreed to sell its Gelsenkirchen refinery in Germany to independent refiner Klesch Group as part of plans to reduce structural costs by US$1bn.
